subject: Request: AzureGrove testimonial + logo approval for feature case study
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@azuregrove.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AzureGrove testimonial + logo approval for feature case study

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our follow-up, we'd love to publish a short customer feature highlighting how AzureGrove used Redwood Dedicated to cut inference cost and standardize latency across teams.

Attached is a draft (redwood-azuregrove-draft-case-study-v1.docx) with:
- 150–250 word customer quote we pulled from your feedback
- Suggested headline and byline
- A small graphic placement for your primary logo and attribution

Can you please confirm the following so we can schedule the case study to publish the week of May 3?
1) Permission to use the quote and company logo (PNG/SVG) on our website and in PDF collateral
2) Any brand guidelines we should follow (clearspace, color, usage examples) — if you have a brand kit, please attach
3) Legal sign-off or any edits your counsel requests. We can route a short release form via DocuSign if easier.

If helpful, Monica and Lauren from our comms team can incorporate any copy edits and share a final proof.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

---

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@azuregrove.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Y. <mark.y@azuregrove.com>, AzureGrove Legal <legal@azuregrove.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzureGrove testimonial + logo approval for feature case study

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for sending the draft. We like the direction — appreciate the concise summary. A few quick notes from product/marketing:
- Please change the sentence in paragraph 2: "reduced inference spend by 3-4x" to "reduced inference per-token cost by up to 3x on high-throughput jobs" (more accurate for our reporting)
- We can provide a high-res SVG of the AzureGrove logo (will send in a follow-up)

I've looped in our legal team (legal@azuregrove.com). They asked that we sign a short release that covers: usage duration (2 years), channels (web, PDF, event slide decks), and attribution. They prefer DocuSign for signatures.

Also copying Mark (product) in case you want a technical pull-quote.

Elena
Senior Director, Customer Marketing
AzureGrove Technologies

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@azuregrove.com>, AzureGrove Legal <legal@azuregrove.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzureGrove testimonial + logo approval for feature case study

Monica / Lauren —

Per Elena's notes: update the cost phrasing to "reduced inference per-token cost by up to 3x on high-throughput jobs", and await SVG from AzureGrove.

Can you:
- Apply the copy edit and produce a final PDF proof (include headline + pull-quote on the first page)
- Draft the short release form with 2-year usage and the three channels Elena mentioned; I'll send the DocuSign link to Elena once legal okays.
- Add our standard brand placement (logo on lower-left, 72px height on web) unless they specify otherwise

Timeline: if we get legal OK and the signed release by Apr 20, we can publish May 3.

I also uploaded the current draft and a working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz-azuregrove-case-study
HubSpot opp: 2345-AG-Opportunity (feel free to add notes)

Thanks —
Marcus

---

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@azuregrove.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: AzureGrove Legal <legal@azuregrove.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Mark Y. <mark.y@azuregrove.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AzureGrove testimonial + logo approval for feature case study

Marcus —

Good news: our legal team reviewed the release and suggested only one minor tweak (clarify that we retain ownership of the logo and can request removal with 30 days' notice). We've signed the attached release via DocuSign: release-form-docusign.pdf

We are happy to proceed with the edited copy (see change above). Also attaching our brand kit (azuregrove-brand-guidelines.zip) in a separate email to you and Monica — it includes SVGs and clearspace rules.

DocuSign transaction: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123-azuregrove-release

Mark also added a short technical pull-quote below that you may use: "Redwood's dedicated pools removed latency variance across our batch pipelines, simplifying our SLO book." — Mark Y.

Please confirm when the final proof is ready and we'll route to our comms team for a last once-over.

Best,
Elena

---

Attachments referenced: redwood-azuregrove-draft-case-study-v1.docx (initial draft), release-form-docusign.pdf (signed release), azuregrove-brand-guidelines.zip (brand kit — sent in follow-up email).

Notes: Thread contains typical sales cadence: initial ask, product/marketing clarifications, legal sign-off via DocuSign, and coordination between Redwood comms (Monica, Lauren) and AzureGrove marketing/legal.
